findings.description: Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-01. Document is a short-form abstract with Parent Names/Father/Mother/Proof Of Relationship all 'N/A' and narrative stating 'does not contain parental information or proof of parental relationship'. Worker returned generic policy text and flagged no defect.
Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-01 (scanned sibling of 89896650). Short-form abstract lacks parental names; no defect or abstention raised.

Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-02. Registration 2025-05-20 for a 2010-03-12 birth (delayed 15 years), civil register entry N/A, authority 'Pending Local Civil Registry Review', 'Provisional/Preliminary' seal. Worker gave generic answer with no credibility/late-registration flag.
Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-02 (scanned sibling). Delayed/late birth registration undetected.

Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-03. Official Seal/Signature/Stamp all 'N/A'; narrative declares 'UNOFFICIAL INFORMATIONAL COPY ... does not bear the embossed official seal, authorized registrar signature, or stamp'. Worker raised no authenticity defect.
Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-03 (scanned sibling). Missing official seal/signature/stamp undetected.

Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-04. Document language Spanish, Translation Certification/Translator Affidavit 'N/A', narrative states 'no incluye traduccion certificada ni declaracion jurada del traductor'. No translation-defect flag raised.
Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-04 (scanned sibling). Untranslated Spanish record without certified translation/affidavit undetected.
Quote field truncated to 'equivalent document from the birth country', which does not substantiate the full three-option claim text asserted in the claim.
Same truncated quote fragment as its sibling; citation does not fully support the claim text.

Provenance shows model 'gemini-3.6-flash' while the required configuration is claude-opus-4.8 with --effort xhigh --context long_context. Model-requirement violation applies uniformly across all 10 reports and likely underlies the systemic non-analysis. No ground-truth leakage detected (blind operation intact).

basis[] asserts unverified context ('The applicant uploaded a birth certificate document for a dependent child') without assessing the actual document; representative of all reports restating policy instead of grounding a verdict in observed fields.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require a per-document adjudication step that emits an explicit verdict (meets_requirements | defective) with defect flags, not a generic policy restatement. Mandate checking these four failure modes against extracted fields/narrative: (1) short-form/abstract missing parent_names/father_full_name/mother_full_name/proof_of_relationship; (2) late/delayed registration where registration_date is years after date_of_birth or authority/seal is 'pending/provisional'; (3) missing official_seal/issuing_authority_signature/issuing_stamp or 'unofficial/unvalidated' narrative; (4) non-English/French document_language lacking translation_certification/translator_affidavit. If any triggers, output a defect claim citing the specific fields.

Instruct the agent to always read page 2 'Narrative Statements / Detailed Notes' and cross-check field values marked 'N/A'/'Not Applicable' against narrative disclaimers (e.g., 'UNOFFICIAL', 'does not bear ... seal', 'short-form ... no parental information', 'delayed registration', 'no incluye traduccion'). Treat 'N/A' on official_seal/signature/stamp or parent fields as a defect signal rather than neutral.

Enforce the mandated worker model/effort (claude-opus-4.8, --effort xhigh, --context long_context) for document review and reject/re-run reports whose provenance.model does not match. Add a guard requiring that reports contain either a defect claim or an explicit affirmative pass with per-field evidence; reject reports that only echo eligibility policy without evaluating the attached document.

rationale: All 10 reports were produced on gemini-3.6-flash (violating the claude-opus-4.8/xhigh requirement) and answered the eligibility question with an identical generic policy restatement instead of adjudicating each attached document. Defect_recall is therefore 0.0 for all 8 defective cases—PFL-01 through PFL-04 were each unambiguously visible in the PDFs (N/A parent fields, 15-year delayed registration, N/A seal/signature/stamp, untranslated Spanish) yet none were flagged and no abstentions were emitted. The two clean cases (64bcdead, d2464043) contain no defects, so defect_recall is scored 1.0 for those. Citation_exactness is generally solid (consistent completeness-check reference with a matching verbatim quote), reduced to 0.6 for 0d8e8114 and ad9e9d39 whose quote fields are truncated to a fragment that does not support the full claim. Grounding_accuracy is moderate (~0.8): the policy claim itself is citation-supported and contains no fabricated facts, but basis[] asserts unverified assumptions and the reports never ground a verdict in observed document fields. PII containment is fully intact—no child/parent names, DOBs, or certificate numbers appear in claims or prose—and blind_input_compliance holds since there is no evidence of ground-truth leakage. The dominant, systemic failure is the complete absence of document-level defect detection, addressed by the patch recommendations.
